sources.title: Vehicle API
sources.accessFormat: Public REST API; page also documents downloadable standalone databases
claimsSupported: vPIC is built around manufacturer-reported VIN-decoding data and has methods for VIN decoding, manufacturers/WMI, make/model and vehicle variables.
Supports partial VINs, batch decoding, JSON/XML/CSV output; recommends model year parameter.
Automated traffic rate control applies; standalone downloads are limited for non-VIN functions.
limitations: U.S. market/compliance data; field completeness varies; an absent variable means NHTSA lacks data for that variable, not that it is zero or not applicable.
Not a global canonical trim/configuration catalog; output is a decoder response, not proof that every returned value applies to every equipment/package variant.
sources.terms: Public documentation and service observed; verify current service terms, rate policy, bulk reuse/storage rights and operational limits before adoption.
sources.freshness: Manufacturer submissions and NHTSA API/database updates; retrieve on demand or schedule bounded refreshes after evaluating rate limits and change detection.

sources.title: NHTSA Product Information Catalog and Vehicle Listing - Home (New Manufacturers Handbook PDF)
sources.publicationDate: March 2014, inferred from file name; accessed 2026-10-01
claimsSupported: The handbook describes manufacturer submissions and NHTSA's MID/vPIC role; WMI assignment/coordination involves SAE.
The retrieved text says vPIC coverage is model year 1981 and later and focuses on vehicles intended for sale/import into the United States.
limitations: The handbook is dated 2014; check current regulations/docs before treating process details as current.
U.S.-oriented VIN decoding does not provide global model/trim/configuration coverage.
sources.terms: Government handbook publicly accessible; this does not grant rights to proprietary SAE WMI datasets or third-party OEM material.
sources.freshness: Regulatory/manufacturer submissions; verify current manufacturer submission process before implementation.

sources.title: ISO 3780:2009 - Road vehicles — World manufacturer identifier (WMI) code
sources.publicationDate: 2009 standard edition (ISO page notes current edition); accessed 2026-10-01
sources.accessFormat: Public scope/metadata and preview; full standard is sold by ISO
claimsSupported: WMI identifies road-vehicle manufacturers worldwide and forms the first section of the VIN specified by ISO 3779.
Scope covers road vehicles including motorcycles, mopeds, trailers and motor vehicles.
limitations: WMI identifies the manufacturer, not an individual AutoResearch trim/configuration or every relevant commercial brand relationship.
The full standard is not freely available; public summary is not a substitute for licensed text.
sources.terms: ISO metadata/preview is accessible; full standard requires purchase/licensing. Do not reproduce standards text or assume licensed reuse.
sources.freshness: Use current ISO edition/corrigenda and validate the assigned WMI with appropriate registration data.

sources.title: Downloads - NHTSA vPIC - Department of Transportation
sources.accessFormat: Public download page; standalone database options
claimsSupported: The official page snippet states downloaded standalone databases are limited to VIN decoding; other make/model/variable/attribute information still requires vPIC APIs.
limitations: Only snippet was saved in this workstream; confirm the current page, database version, coverage and terms before use.
sources.terms: Verify download/API use terms and update cadence before storing/redistributing derived data.
sources.freshness: Check vPIC release/version metadata; do not assume standalone files contain every API dataset.

sources.title: WMI/VIN Information - Standards Development - Standards - SAE International
sources.accessFormat: Public standards landing page; WMI database and standards are referenced
claimsSupported: SAE page identifies ISO 3779 (VIN content/structure), ISO 3780 (WMI), and an SAE WMI Database.
limitations: Search snippet does not establish database coverage, access mechanics, currentness or exact public/paid terms.
sources.terms: Treat WMI database as potentially licensed; verify access and redistribution rights directly with SAE before adoption.
sources.freshness: Verify registry updates and historical reassignment/identity semantics with SAE.

sources.title: NHTSA Product Information Catalog and Vehicle Listing (vPIC) - VIN Decoder | Department of Transportation - Data Portal
sources.accessFormat: Public DOT data portal catalog description
claimsSupported: vPIC's stated purpose is centralized basic VIN decoding, MID/manufacturer plant identification and associated data.
limitations: Catalog description is not a complete field-level schema or license; use API docs for method details.
sources.terms: Verify API and data reuse terms directly; public portal availability does not by itself define redistribution rights.
sources.freshness: Check actual API/documentation release and submission timestamps.

sources.title: Welcome to VIN Decoding :: provided by vPIC
sources.accessFormat: Public web decoder backed by vPIC
claimsSupported: NHTSA accepts partial VINs; an explicitly entered model year overrides the VIN-encoded model year; Canadian vehicle specifications are referenced.
limitations: A VIN decoder response is not a complete market-wide trim taxonomy or a VIN-specific current-recall status.
sources.terms: Web tool is public; verify programmatic endpoint use and storage terms rather than assuming UI permission authorizes bulk use.
sources.freshness: Decode again as needed when NHTSA manufacturer-submitted data updates; retain retrieval date and raw response.
